svg.title: Two FortiGate FGCP HA pairs joined by IPsec, with per-customer GRE isolation
svg.desc: Site A and site B each have east and west spoke VPCs behind a Transit Gateway, a TGW Connect GRE tunnel per customer to an FGCP HA pair, and an IPsec tunnel between the sites that carries one GRE tunnel per customer. A shared management VPC holds FortiManager and FortiAnalyzer.
svg.text: own IGW, attached to neither TGW; same account and AZs as the FortiGate ENIs
FortiGate port4 ENIs · site A: .20, .84 · site B: .21, .85 · FGFM and log traffic only, VRF 1
Each customer has its own VRF (east 10, west 20), its own GRE tunnels and its own firewall policy. GRE to the TGW terminates on the primary only and does not move on failover.
